text.body: bālākaprabhā iṃdranīla jaṭhīlaṃ | bhasmāṃgarā gotvalaṃ | śāntaṃnāda vilīda cittapavanaṃ | śārdūla canmāṃbaraṃ | brahmadyesanakādī visvarī vrīdaṃ | siddhaisamārādhitaṃ | ātreyaṃ samūpāsmagheghrudīmūdā | gheyaṃ sadā yogībhīḥ | digaṃbaraṃ bhasmavilepitāṃgaṃ | cakraṃ triśūlaṃ ḍamarūṃ gadāṃca | padmāsanastaṃ śaśīsūjñanetraṃ | dattātreyaṃ gheya vabhīṣṭa siddhye | oṃ namośrī gurūṃdattaṃ | datta devaṃ jagadaguruṃ | niṣkalaṃ nirguṇaṃ vaṃde | dattātreyaṃ namāmyahaṃ | brahmālokeśabhūteśa | śaṃkha cakra gadādharaṃ | pāṇīpātradharaṃdevaṃ | dattātreyaṃ namāmyahaṃ | sureśa vaṃditaṃ devaṃ | trailokya lokavaṃditaṃ | hariharātmakaṃdevaṃ | dattātreyaṃ namāmyahaṃ | nirmalaṃ nīla varṇaṃca | suṃdaraṃ śāmaśobhitaṃ | sulocanaṃ viśālākṣaṃ | dattātreyaṃ namāmyahaṃ | triśūlaṃ ḍamarūṃmālā | jaṭāmukuṭamaṃḍitaṃ | maṃḍitaṃ kuṃḍalaṃ karṇe | dattātreyaṃ namāmyahaṃ | vibhūtīṃbhūṣitaṃdehaṃ | hāra keyūra śobhitaṃ | anantapraṇavākāraṃ | śrī dattātreyaṃ namāmyahaṃ | prasannavadanaṃ devaṃ | bhukti bhuktī pradāyakaṃ | janārdhanam jagatrāṇaṃ | dattātreyaṃ namāmyahaṃ | rājarājaṃ nidācāraṃ | kārtavīryavarapradaṃ | subhadraṃbhadrakalyāṇam | dattātreyaṃ namāmyahaṃ | anasūyā priyakaraṃ | atriputraṃ sureśvaraṃ | vikhyāta yogīnāṃmokṣaṃ | dattātreyaṃ namāmyahaṃ | digaṃbara tanūṃśreṣṭhaṃ | brahmasajjyapradesthitaṃ | haṃsaṃkhaṃ sātmakaṃ nityaṃ | dattātreyaṃ namāmyahaṃ | kadāyogī kadābhogī | bālalīlā vinodagraha | daśanairatnasaṃkāśaihī | dattātreyaṃ namāmyahaṃ | bhūtavātā bhavatrāsaha | grahapīḍātathaivaca | daridryabhyasandvaṃbhī | dattātreyaṃ namāmyahaṃ | caturdaśyāṃ budhevāre | janmamārgaśīreśubhe | sārakaṃ vipulaṃ vaṃde | dattātreyaṃ namāmyahaṃ | raktotpala dalaṃpādaṃ | sarvatīrthaṃ samud‍bhavaṃ | vaṃditaṃ yogī viddtbaihī | dattātreyaṃ namāmyahaṃ | jñānadādā prabhūsākṣādī | gatirmokṣa pradāyine | ātmabhūrīśvara kṛṣṇaka | dattātreyaṃ namāmyahaṃ | bhṛgūvinacitamidaṃ | dattātreyapārāyaṇāṃ vidaṃ | sākṣāt yad‌vccayaṃ brahmā | dattātreyaṃ namāmyahaṃ | prāṇīnāṃsad‍bajantunāṃ | karmapāśa prabhaṃjanaṃ | dattātreya stutīstotraṃ | sarvāṃkāmānavāpuṇyāta | abudhrolaghade putraṃ | dhanadhānya samanvitaḥ | rājamājyobhavet lakṣmīḥ | aprāpyaṃ prāpnujātanaraha | trisaṃdyaṃjapamānastu | dattātreya stutīṃ sadā | tasyaroga bhayaṃnāstī | dirghāyurvijayībhavete | kuṣmāṃḍa ḍākinī bhakṣaka | piśāca brahmarākṣasaḥ | stotrasya śrudamātreṇa | gacchaṃjatraṇasaṃśayaḥ | etad dviśatī ślokānāṃ | āvṛttīṃ puru viṃśaṃtīṃ | tasyāvṛttī sahastreṇa | darśanaṃnātra saṃśayaḥ |
